title: Casa Muditā - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌴 Why Guests Love Staying Here

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties for a smooth, worry-free vacation

🛏️ 4 bedrooms & 3.5 bathrooms — comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests, perfect for families & groups

🏖️ Exclusive Discounts for Bikes, Golf Cart and Beach Gear

🎣 Park directly across the street featuring charcoal grills, fishing dock, boat ramp & lake access for outdoor fun

🛶 Paddleboard from the lake straight to the beach for a unique coastal adventure

🚶‍♀️ Easy public beach access just a short walk away — no long drives or parking hassles

🏊 Community pool just steps from the home for quick and easy swims

👶 Pack ’n Play provided (please bring your own sheets) for families traveling with little ones

📍 Located in a peaceful neighborhood close to dining, shopping & outdoor adventures along Scenic Highway 30A

Welcome to Casa Muditā, a newly built 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Nestled just south of Scenic Highway 30A, this home offers the perfect mix of coastal fun and peaceful lakeside living.

Directly across the street, a family-friendly park features charcoal grills, a fishing dock, and access to Eastern Lake—one of 30A’s most beautiful coastal dune lakes. Guests can kayak, fish, or even paddle board directly from the lake out to the Gulf.

The community pool is just outside the front door along a short walking path, making it easy to cool off after the beach.

Inside, the home blends modern comfort with coastal style. The open-concept main floor boasts a bright kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a large dining area, and a cozy living space perfect for gathering after a day on the water. Upstairs, 4 spacious bedrooms (2 king and 2 queen) offer private and shared baths, plus a balcony with relaxing views.

When you’re ready for sand and surf, the nearest public beach access is just a quick ride away.

Guests also enjoy peaceful walking trails and easy access to 30A’s shops, restaurants, and state parks—all just minutes away.

Whether you’re seeking adventure on the water, family beach days, or evenings exploring 30A, Casa Muditā delivers it all.

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation. *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.

Golf cart is not included in rental and is a separate rental/fee.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
